I've read through the current settings. Here's a plan.

## Current state

The Settings screen [config_mode.cpp:16-30](bgeigiezen_firmware/screens/config_mode.cpp#L16-L30) is a flat list of 13 entries:

`View settings · Start Access Point · Start on local · Load from SD · Save to SD · Wipe SD Card · Reset dose · CPM Alert Level · Audio Settings · Dim Brightness · Set Home GPS · Factory reset · Back`

Plus, on the main menu [menu_window.cpp:19-30](bgeigiezen_firmware/screens/menu_window.cpp#L19-L30), `Debug info` and `About Zen` live next to operational modes — they're really utility/info screens, not modes.

## Proposed Settings tree

```
Settings
├── Display
│     • Dim brightness        (existing page)
│     • Display unit CPM↔uSv/h  (today read-only on "View settings")
│     • Dim timeout              (today read-only)
│     • Off timeout              (today read-only)
│     • Screensaver on/off       (today read-only)
│     • Back
│
├── GPS
│     • Set Home GPS              (existing page)
│     • Max DOP                   (today read-only)
│     • Back
│
├── Sound
│     • Volume / Clicks / Alarm   (existing Audio Settings page, unchanged)
│     • CPM alert level           (existing — it's the alarm trigger, fits here)
│     • Back
│
├── SD card
│     • Load config from SD       (existing)
│     • Save config to SD         (existing)
│     • Wipe SD card              (existing)
│     • Back
│
├── WiFi
│     • Start Access Point        (existing)
│     • Start on local network    (existing)

```

Main menu shrinks from 10 → 8 entries (drop `About Zen`, `Debug info`).

## Old → new mapping (no features lost)

|-----|--------------|
| View settings | Distributed into Display / GPS / WiFi / Utilities › About this device |
| Start Access Point | WiFi |
| Start on local | WiFi |

## Other suggestions

1. **CPM alert under Sound** — it's the threshold that triggers the *audible* alarm; it groups naturally with Volume/Clicks/Alarm. If you'd rather keep it as a "Geiger/Detector" idea, we could add a 7th category but I'd avoid the extra depth.
2. **Promote read-only fields to editable where it's safe** — `Display unit (CPM/uSv/h)`, `Screensaver on/off`, `Manual vs auto logging` are simple toggles that today are only changeable via web UI. Worth offering on-device while we're touching this.
3. **"About this device"** — fold the most-asked info onto one page: device ID, firmware version, MAC, SD free space, uptime. Currently scattered between `View settings`, `Debug info` and `About Zen`.
4. **Drop "View settings" as a top-level entry** — its content disappears into the right category page; saves one tap and one screen of code.
5. **Keep the renderers, change the menu only** — `render_audio_page`, `render_dim_brightness_page`, `render_cpm_threshold_page`, `render_set_home_gps_page`, `render_sd_wipe`, `render_reset_device_sd`, `render_page_ap`, `render_page_wifi` are all reusable as-is.

## Implementation approach

Two options. I'd recommend **A**.

**A. One file per submenu (cleaner, matches existing pattern)**
- Add 6 new `BaseScreenWithMenu` classes: `DisplaySettingsScreen`, `GpsSettingsScreen`, `SoundSettingsScreen`, `SdSettingsScreen`, `WifiSettingsScreen`, `UtilitiesScreen` in [bgeigiezen_firmware/screens/](bgeigiezen_firmware/screens/).
- Shrink `ConfigModeScreen` to just the 7-entry top menu — it becomes a router, ~50 lines.
- Move existing render methods (`render_audio_page`, etc.) into the appropriate submenu class. No rendering logic changes.
- Each submenu's "Back" returns `&ConfigModeScreen_i`; ConfigModeScreen's "Back to main menu" still returns `&MenuWindow_i`.
- Remove `Debug info` and `About Zen` from `MAIN_MENU_ITEMS`; reach them via Utilities.

**B. Single file, two-level state machine (smaller diff, more crowded file)**
- Keep one `ConfigModeScreen` but add a `_category` field and dispatch to one of 6 sub-menu arrays. Already-637-line file gets larger.

**Estimated diff for A:** ~6 small new files (~80 lines each), [config_mode.cpp](bgeigiezen_firmware/screens/config_mode.cpp) reduced significantly, [menu_window.cpp](bgeigiezen_firmware/screens/menu_window.cpp) loses 2 entries, [menu_window.h](bgeigiezen_firmware/screens/menu_window.h) `MAIN_MENU_MAX 10 → 8`. No worker / handler / storage changes.

Want me to go ahead with option A? If so I'll run `gitnexus_impact` on `ConfigModeScreen` and `MAIN_MENU_ITEMS` first per [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md), report blast radius, then start.
